title: SocraticRepair: Planning-Guided Socratic Tutoring for Program Debugging and Misconception Repair
abstract: arXiv:2610.15204v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large language models are increasingly used in computer science education. However, the teaching abilities of even the most powerful LLMs are limited: they tend to reveal the solution prematurely and may lose focus on the learner's current debugging objective. To address this, we introduce SocraticRepair, a planning-guided Socratic tutoring framework for program debugging and miscon- ception repair that adapts prior planning-guided tutoring work (Li et al., 2026b). The framework is instantiated in the Python programming domain by fine-tuning Qwen2.5-Coder-7B-Instruct on synthetic multi-turn tutoring dialogues constructed from four preprocessed programming datasets. The system is evaluated using a predefined set of independent metrics and benchmarked against a general-purpose LLM. translated_title: SocraticRepair：面向程序调试与误解修复的规划引导式苏格拉底教学法
translated_abstract: 大语言模型在计算机科学教育中的应用日益广泛。然而，即使是最强大的LLM，其教学能力也存在局限：它们往往过早地透露答案，并且可能会偏离学习者当前的调试目标。为了解决这一问题，我们提出了SocraticRepair，这是一个面向程序调试与误解修复的规划引导式苏格拉底教学法框架，它改编自先前的规划引导式教学研究工作。该框架在Python编程领域中得到具体实现，通过在由四个预处理编程数据集构建的合成多轮教学对话上对Qwen2.5-Coder-7B-Instruct进行微调。该系统使用一组预定义的独立指标进行评估，并与通用大语言模型进行基准对比。实验表明，SocraticRepair在逐步式脚手架支持和提问质量方面取得了更高的分数，同时显著减少了过早透露答案的情况。
tldr: 提出SocraticRepair框架，通过规划引导的苏格拉底式教学法进行程序调试教学，在脚手架支持和提问质量上优于通用LLM，并显著减少过早透露答案的问题。
en_tdlr: SocraticRepair is a planning-guided Socratic tutoring framework for program debugging and misconception repair that outperforms general-purpose LLMs in stepwise scaffolding and question quality while substantially reducing premature solution disclosure.
